messages.author: f6dea426c8b7a030
messages.subject: rendering a "dot" file at shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi, 
I am trying to deploy the app LoopModelExplorer in the package LevinsLoops.
Runs fine at home.
The renderImage() expression creates a "dot" file,
using a function from a different package:
           LoopAnalyst:graph.cm()
This produces a "dot" file, which I convert to gif as follows:
system(paste("dot -Tgif -O ", dotFileCM),
           ignore.stdout=TRUE, ignore.stderr = TRUE)
and return value is:
outfile = paste0(dotFileCM, ".gif")
list(src = outfile,
         height=300, width=400,
         alt = "CM should be here")
Renders beautifully when run locally.
But I can't find an executable "dot" at shinyapps.io.
However, there is a directory tree 
/usr/lib/graphviz
I don't know graphviz well...
is there a way to convert from the "dot" file out there in shinyapps-system-land?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] rendering a "dot" file at shinyapps.io
parts:
I am not sure if "dot" is installed on the base Linux image.  I am guessing that the LoopAnalyst package should have a system dependency on it.

Would you mind filing a request for it at this repo:  https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps-package-dependencies
